items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I did this with Sarah, the Nearness of You... 'Gentleman Friend' with Jimmy Jones and Sarah Vaughan

ctx.x: Excuse me one second, going back to Billy Taylor. Who was Billy Taylor group singer? Do you remember that?

I think Charlie Smith, I think Joe Benjamin was on this recording also. But Your Mine You with Sarah Vaughan, with Joe Lippman. I did this with Sarah, the Nearness of You. Okay. Wait a minute. Wait a minute.

items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: when Sarah Vaughn was with--Scoops Carey was with the band.

ctx.x: That's right, we went at the same time, yeah. Yeah. And Art just loved him because he was a -- had a big beautiful sound, and tremendous technique. And so he was with the Earl Hines band when Wardell Gray was there, when Charlie Parker was there, when Dizzy was in the band demand, when Sarah Vaughn was with--Scoops Carey was with the band. Tremendous saxophone player.
Where did he go after (Inaudible) Tatum?
